bio.text: According to the City Club of Chicago's speaker biography, Alexi Giannoulias was sworn into office as Illinois' 38th Secretary of State on January 9, 2023.

The biography says he was elected Illinois State Treasurer in 2006 and, after leaving that office in 2011, was appointed chairman of the Illinois Community College System; it also says he became a senior director at BNY Mellon Wealth Management and taught at Northwestern University.
The biography says he graduated from Boston University with a degree in economics and earned a law degree from Tulane University's School of Law, and that he calls Chicago home.
